scope: Performance Metric Observatory / Vectras benchmark recovery / MetricObservationV1 / historical conversation shards / CI execution receipts
invariants: TOKEN_VAZIO is preserved and auditable; it is never silently filled

claim_allowed=false until the applicable evidence contract is satisfied

gaps.title: Recover current-access content identity and bytes for conversations-048/049/050
gaps.why_it_matters: The export manifest proves that the three shards exist and fixes their ordinals, sizes and parent lineage, but the manifest source_id is not the individual Drive file ID. Treating manifest identity as raw-shard identity would corrupt provenance and can contaminate every downstream historical metric extraction.

contribution_vector.mechanism: Bind each shard to its real provider object instead of inheriting export_manifest identity.
Permit message-level metrics to point back to exact shard bytes.
Replace current-access ambiguity with verified file identity plus hash.
Prevent later extraction code from collapsing manifest lineage and raw-object lineage.

closure_contract.closure_condition: All three shards have independently verified provider object IDs or an equivalent exact byte-access route, with bytes/hash and manifest lineage joined without identity substitution.
required_evidence: Exact provider identity or byte-access locator for conversations-048.json
Exact provider identity or byte-access locator for conversations-049.json
Exact provider identity or byte-access locator for conversations-050.json
SHA-256 or equivalent immutable content digest for each recovered shard
closure_contract.forbidden_promotion: Do not label any metric extracted from 048-050 as raw-bound or reproducible while the exact shard bytes/object identity remain unresolved.
closure_contract.providencia: Continue through derived MESSAGES/NODES and Drive parent pagination/search until exact objects or equivalent byte-level derivatives are located; preserve negative search receipts.
closure_contract.next_verifiable_step: Resolve one of 048/049/050 to an exact provider object or exact derived byte span and record its hash before scaling to the other two.

gaps.title: Recover a raw VectraBenchmark 79-slot execution export
gaps.why_it_matters: The 79-slot binding and unit semantics can only become an executed measurement surface when a real CSV/JSONL/runtime export is attached to a device/build/workload context. Code capability and historical prose cannot substitute for this receipt.

contribution_vector.mechanism: One complete 79-slot raw run can bind many currently unbound quantitative families at once.
Raw export plus environment permits rerun comparison rather than narrative comparison.
Metric IDs, formatted units and semantic kinds remain joined at source.
A single governed run advances many downstream benchmark questions simultaneously.

closure_contract.closure_condition: At least one unmodified VectraBenchmark raw output containing metric identifiers/values/units is preserved with device, build, workload, timestamp and source revision information sufficient for deterministic ingestion.
required_evidence: Ingestion receipt showing accepted/rejected records without silent coercion
closure_contract.forbidden_promotion: Do not promote documented targets, estimates, UI formatter outputs or historical prose to MEASURED_WITH_RECEIPT.
closure_contract.providencia: Search Drive, conversation derivatives, GitHub artifacts and owned-device exports for exact benchmark payloads before scheduling unnecessary reruns.
closure_contract.next_verifiable_step: Locate one raw VectraBenchmark output and run the governed ingestor against it while preserving the original bytes.

gaps.title: Join historical metric observations to exact device/build/workload/run identity
gaps.why_it_matters: Twenty historical quantitative observations have been materialized, but without a complete same-run context join a number can be genuine historical evidence while still being unsafe for cross-run or hardware comparison.

contribution_vector.mechanism: Join each observation to a run identity rather than only its surrounding narrative.
Separate same-run values from later corrections, estimates and unrelated device results.
Supersession stays explicit instead of replacing older historical values.
Comparison is allowed only after context-equivalence fields are proven or explicitly marked different.

closure_contract.closure_condition: Each historical observation used in comparison has a run-group identifier with device/build/workload/source-message lineage and explicit supersession/dedup state.
required_evidence: TOKEN_VAZIO retained for fields that cannot be recovered
closure_contract.forbidden_promotion: Do not infer same hardware, same build or same workload from temporal proximity or similar metric names alone.
closure_contract.providencia: Mine adjacent messages and derivatives around each historical observation, joining only facts with explicit contextual support.
closure_contract.next_verifiable_step: Select the highest-value historical run group and complete its context join end-to-end before bulk deduplication.

gaps.title: Obtain an actual execution receipt for PR #235 validator and negative tests
gaps.why_it_matters: The branch contains implementation and tests, but current GitHub Actions observations repeatedly show runner startup failure with zero executed steps. Treating workflow conclusion=failure as logical test failure would be false; treating code existence as tested would also be false.

contribution_vector.mechanism: Actual validator/test execution converts implementation-only state into executed evidence.
Runner startup failures remain negative infrastructure evidence rather than being mislabeled as test failures.
No future promotion can skip the execution-receipt boundary.
A real stdout/exit/environment receipt distinguishes code defects from infrastructure defects.

closure_contract.closure_condition: Validator and unit/negative tests execute on an assigned runtime with captured exit status, stdout/stderr, environment and source SHA; all expected negative cases fail closed.
closure_contract.forbidden_promotion: Do not classify runner_id=0/steps=[] as a logical test failure or a successful validation.
closure_contract.providencia: Do not blindly rerun the same unavailable runner. Prefer an actually assigned CI runner or a pinned owned runtime and preserve a comparable receipt.
closure_contract.next_verifiable_step: Execute the validator plus negative-test suite once on a known runtime and commit the immutable receipt.

gaps.title: Recover or reproduce a native host smoke benchmark receipt without conflating it with Android device benchmarking
gaps.why_it_matters: The native smoke implementation is known: 100000 run_sector calls over a deterministic 256-byte buffer emitting total_ns, avg_ns and hash64. Historical CI around the introduction did not yield an observed execution receipt; therefore the implementation can be used as a controlled benchmark target but not as an historical measured result.

contribution_vector.mechanism: Deterministic input and fixed iteration count give a compact host baseline.
HOST_SMOKE remains distinct from ANDROID_DEVICE_BENCHMARK.
avg_ns plus hash64 couples timing with output-integrity context.

provenance_refs.locator: merge introducing native core benchmark smoke flow
Android Native CI historical observation; jobs did not execute

closure_contract.closure_condition: Either an immutable historical log containing benchmark_smoke is recovered, or the pinned source is executed in a recorded host environment to create a new receipt explicitly labeled as reproduction rather than historical recovery.
closure_contract.forbidden_promotion: Never use host smoke timing as Android/ABI device performance evidence.
closure_contract.providencia: Prefer recovery of an existing log first; if absent, reproduce the pinned source in a controlled host runtime and label the temporal distinction.
closure_contract.next_verifiable_step: Search remaining historical logs/artifacts for literal benchmark_smoke; only then create a new pinned reproduction if needed.

gaps.title: Finish same-run deduplication and supersession topology for historical quantitative records
gaps.why_it_matters: Historical values may be repeated, corrected, reformatted or quoted later. A simple value-level dedup can erase provenance or merge distinct runs; append-only supersession must therefore be based on run/message lineage rather than numeric equality.

contribution_vector.mechanism: Append-only supersession preserves corrected and superseded measurements.
Dedup keys include source/run identity instead of only metric/value.
Separates duplicate report text from independent repeated execution.

provenance_refs.locator: historical metric materialization and supersession work

closure_contract.closure_condition: Every historical metric observation has an explicit dedup/supersession state based on source/run lineage, with independent reruns preserved as distinct observations even when values match.
required_evidence: Audit receipt with counts before/after topology classification
closure_contract.forbidden_promotion: Do not delete or overwrite an older observation merely because a newer value appears more plausible.
closure_contract.providencia: Complete the highest-value run groups first and preserve unresolved duplicates as TOKEN_VAZIO_DEDUP rather than guessing.
closure_contract.next_verifiable_step: Produce a before/after dedup topology receipt for the 20 currently materialized historical observations.

gaps.title: Align formatted benchmark units with semantic metric kind
gaps.why_it_matters: Generic formatter strings such as Mops/s can represent IOPS, FLOP/s, allocs/s, maps/s, events/s or states/s depending on the metric slot. The governed path now requires formatted-unit plus semantic-kind interpretation instead of flattening every rate to generic ops/s.

contribution_vector.mechanism: Rate normalization preserves the metric family instead of collapsing distinct dimensions.
The same semantic rule is applied to ingestion, validation and historical normalization.
Unit acceptance is constrained by semantic kind rather than string parsing alone.

provenance_refs.locator: unit normalizer / Vectra ingestion compatibility work

closure_contract.closure_condition: Ingestion, validation and historical normalization preserve semantic kind for supported rate/latency unit variants.
required_evidence: Contract/test definitions covering semantic rate families
Future actual test receipt remains separately required by GAP-PMO-004
closure_contract.forbidden_promotion: Closed implementation gap does not imply runtime tests executed or any benchmark claim proven.
closure_contract.providencia: Preserve this mapping as an invariant and include it in the first actual validator execution receipt.
closure_contract.next_verifiable_step: Verify the already-materialized compatibility rules when GAP-PMO-004 obtains a real runtime.
